title: Authors
description: All authors, as a map keyed by author id (the slug used in `author:` front matter).

type.description: Whether the author is a person or an organization.

siteDefault.description: Marks the site's default author (exactly one author must set this).

displayName.description: A shorter name for the DOM (bylines, author page heading).

profileImage.description: Site-relative path to the author's image.

addCopyrightNotice.description: Opt into a per-post copyright notice.
